name: lexis-phase2-page-aware-extraction
description: The fixed Phase 1 questions relabelled against the 404-chunk Phase 2 index of Gov-AR_1 test.pdf. The index uses conservative page-level cleaning, page-bounded character chunks, and a visible source-page prefix. Labels were identified from the complete generated chunk set before retrieval evaluation.

cases.question: What were Pakistan's average NCPI inflation rates in FY25 and FY24?
cases.reference_answer: Average NCPI inflation was 4.5 percent in FY25, down from 23.4 percent in FY24.
cases.notes: Relevant evidence occurs on PDF pages 18 and 29; all three chunks contain both rates.

cases.question: By how many basis points did the MPC reduce policy rates between June 2024 and June 2025?
cases.reference_answer: The MPC reduced policy rates by 1,100 basis points.
cases.notes: Chunk 19 on PDF page 18 states both the amount and exact period.

cases.question: How did Pakistan's public debt-to-GDP ratio change from FY24 to FY25?
cases.reference_answer: It rose from 67.7 percent in FY24 to 70.8 percent in FY25.
cases.notes: The page-bounded chunk on PDF page 28 contains the complete comparison.

cases.question: To what rate did broad money (M2) growth decelerate in FY25, and what was its rate in the previous year?
cases.reference_answer: M2 growth decelerated to 13.7 percent in FY25 from 16 percent in the previous year.
cases.notes: Overlapping chunks 74 and 75 on PDF page 28 contain both rates.

cases.question: After the January 2025 revision, what inflation projection range did the MPC adopt, and what real GDP growth range did it maintain?
cases.reference_answer: The MPC revised inflation to 5.5-7.5 percent and maintained real GDP growth at 2.5-3.5 percent.
cases.notes: Page 45 contains prose and table evidence. The PDF text layer repeats part of the table, so all sufficient overlapping passages remain labelled while the limitation is documented.

cases.question: How much did the banking sector gain from the sale of government securities during FY25?
cases.reference_answer: The banking sector recorded gains of Rs 117 billion during FY25.
cases.notes: The figure appears in footnote passages on PDF pages 56 and 58.

cases.question: What is Climate Risk Fund-I for microfinance banks intended to achieve?
cases.reference_answer: It is intended to promote climate-resilient farming and provide liquidity support to small farmers affected by floods.
cases.notes: Chunk 26 on PDF page 19 contains both stated purposes.

cases.question: How many new IFSB standards did SBP adopt during FY2024-25, and what total did that bring the adopted standards to?
cases.reference_answer: SBP adopted six new IFSB standards, bringing the total to ten.
cases.notes: Two overlapping chunks on PDF page 40 contain the complete answer.

cases.question: How many AAOIFI Shariah standards did SBP adopt during FY2024-25?
cases.reference_answer: SBP adopted nine AAOIFI Shariah standards during FY2024-25.
cases.notes: Chunk 153 on PDF page 41 contains the count.

cases.question: By the end of June 2025, how many people had received training under the National Financial Literacy Program, and what share were women?
cases.reference_answer: Nearly 4.4 million people had been trained, half of whom were women.
cases.notes: Chunk 316 on PDF page 72 contains the date, total, and share.

cases.question: What does the acronym PRISM+ stand for?
cases.reference_answer: PRISM+ stands for Pakistan Real-Time Interbank Settlement Mechanism Plus.
cases.notes: The full expansion appears in the Governor's remarks on PDF page 19 and abbreviation list on page 89.

cases.question: Under which statutory provision was the Governor's Annual Report submitted to Parliament?
cases.reference_answer: It was submitted under Section 39(1) of the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956.
cases.notes: The statement occurs in letters on PDF pages 10 and 12.

cases.question: What financial inclusion level and gender-gap targets does NFIS 2024-28 set for 2028?
cases.reference_answer: It targets 75 percent financial inclusion and a reduction of the gender gap to 25 percent by 2028.
cases.notes: The two targets appear together on PDF pages 19 and 73.

cases.question: What Bitcoin reserve target did SBP set for FY25?
cases.notes: The complete cleaned PDF and generated chunks contain no Bitcoin reserve target; this remains diagnostic-only until relevance thresholding exists.
